An ancient '''artifact''' held a religious significance to the [[Khil]]<ref name="Senatorial Search" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belnar/Legends|Belnar]].<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">{{TOR_dates|1}} Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Senatorial Search" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Unidentified Belnar Senator|senator]] from Belnar went missing along with the artifact. An individual sent a companion to Belnar to find the lost [[Senator/Legends|senator]]. Upon doing so, the companion tricked the senator into confessing that he had the artifact in his possession, and the item was subsequently returned to the grateful Khil.<ref name="Senatorial Search" />
{{Endgame}}
